label: Bible Study
prompt: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more _____ way.
verse: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
note: Paul's bridge into the love chapter — 'a more excellent way' turns the page to chapter 13.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The _____ appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
verse: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
note: Winter's over, flowers are up, the birds are singing — the Bible's prettiest spring morning.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is _____ in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
verse: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
note: Gideon's objection: my family is poor and I'm the least in my father's house — just the kind of man God likes to use.

label: Deep Water
prompt: A false _____ is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
verse: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
note: Rigged merchant scales were a common cheat; God calls them an abomination and honest weights his delight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There is therefore now no _____ to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verse: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
note: After Romans 7's wrestling, chapter 8 opens with the verdict: 'no condemnation' for those in Christ Jesus.
